_doc: Orc and Vampyr stage-1 blockouts rendered by the sprite pipeline (CC0 MPFB bodies; plate as shells conformed to the body plus Blender primitives, kit_extras.py), reduced to core + heartland with the outline on the silhouette only, speckle merged and the tokens hand-edited (token_edits.json). Cast fix after the slop audit of 2026-10-15. Round 3 (2026-10-16): bodies, tokens and normal strips hand-repainted part by part in palette ramps (tools/look/cast_r3/); heads kept from the render. Round 4 (2026-10-16, tools/look/cast_r4/): the orc repainted inside the round-2 alpha (bulk back), skin on the green-grey skin_orc ramp, tusks in bone 3 (director: 'bulk and green-grey skin'); the Vampyr in his own armour (slim spaulders, no fauld box) with a fanned cape; tokens are the SE frames at half scale. Round 5 (2026-10-16, tools/look/cast_r5/): the orc's heads hand-placed as planes (broad jaw, brow shelf, mouth, tusks from the lower jaw), skin on the moss-hue skin_orc ramp, plate one iron step darker; the Vampyr's armour darker with a cuirass ridge and the cape lining showing at the front; the orc token head by hand. Round 6 (2026-10-16, tools/look/cast_r6/): the orc's heads rebuilt as skulls (rounded crown, brow arches, ears, nose, neck, a sloped back in profile) on a mossier skin_orc ramp; the orc token head redrawn so the tusks cross a straight mouth; the Vampyr's breastplate tapered to the waist with a plackart line and fauld lames, the lining as cape folds, and the E/W jaw blob replaced by a jaw line.
status: prototype sprites for the golden references; cast fix awaiting the director's look approval
